distinguishing_features: Onkyo NR-series 2022 generation, 7.2-ch, THX Certified Select (the NR5100 is not THX), 6 HDMI in / 2 out, powered Zone 2 speaker terminals + HDMI Sub/Zone 2 out, MM phono input, front USB. Front panel printed 'AV RECEIVER TX-NR6100', input row includes a PHONO key, button above first key reads 'ZONE 2', Dynamic Audio Amplification logo top-right, front USB next to SETUP MIC. Sibling TX-NR7100 is 9.2-ch (Dirac). 230V (European/Asian) variant applies in Israel; black only.

conflicts.supplier_claim: 210 וואט לערוץ (supplier price list, row TX-NR6100)
conflicts.manufacturer: 210 W is the North American rating at 10% THD: "210 W at 6 ohms, 1 kHz, 1 ch driven of 10% THD" (manual, North American models; US product sheet "210 W/Ch (6 ohms, 1 kHz, 10% THD, 1 channel driven)"). European/Asian 230V models are rated 7 ch × 165 W at 6 ohms, 1 kHz, 1% THD (IEC) (manual + EMEA spec sheet); European max effective output 175 W (6 ohms, 1 kHz, 10% THD, JEITA). US FTC rating: 100 W/Ch (8 ohms, 20 Hz–20 kHz, 0.08% THD, 2-ch driven).
conflicts.resolution: spec_facts uses the 230V IEC rating with full conditions; do NOT write a bare '210W' in copy.

features.text: THX Certified Select with four THX listening modes: cinema, gaming, music and surround EX
7.2-channel network AV receiver with 5.2.2-ch Dolby Atmos and DTS:X playback
Dolby Atmos Height Virtualizer and DTS Virtual:X; Dolby Surround and DTS Neural:X upmixing
HDMI 2.1 on inputs 1–3 and both outputs: 8K/60, 4K/120, VRR, ALLM, QFT, QMS, eARC (Main Out); HDR10+ and Dolby Vision
Discrete Zone 2 HDMI switching — a second room/display with its own 4K/8K source
Powered Zone 2 speaker terminals: switch between 7.2/5.2.2-ch and 5.2-ch + Zone 2
MM phono input with built-in equalizer
AccuEQ room calibration with AccuReflex phase matching for Atmos-enabled speakers (setup microphone included)
Works with Sonos (Sonos Port required), Chromecast built-in, AirPlay 2, DTS Play-Fi; works with Alexa / Hey Google devices (sold separately)
Built-in Spotify, TIDAL, Deezer, TuneIn, Pandora, Amazon Music HD; Roon Tested
Bi-directional Bluetooth: receive SBC/AAC, transmit SBC/aptX/aptX HD (24-bit) to headphones
Klipsch Optimize Mode — preset crossover values for Klipsch Reference / Reference Premiere speakers
Precision 192kHz/24-bit D/A conversion; Hi-Res playback via network and USB incl. DSD256 and 192kHz/24-bit FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF

in_the_box: Indoor FM/DAB+ antenna and AM loop antenna
